source_of_truth: goatai functions/serve-api/house_portfolio.js canonicalJson and manifestSha256 (OPS-33 v1.1); test: functions/serve-api/test_house_portfolio.cjs
sync: The GOAT Portfolio Desktop app vendors this file byte-identically and runs every case against its own canonicaliser. Change it here first, then copy the same bytes; never edit one copy alone. The file is pure ASCII: every non-ASCII character is a \uXXXX escape, and each input keeps its original number spelling.
rule: canonical = RFC 8785 JCS of input: object members sorted by the UTF-16 code units of their names, no whitespace, arrays in order, numbers as ECMAScript Number-to-String (JSON.stringify; -0 is 0, 1e21 is 1e+21), strings and names as JSON.stringify writes them; non-finite numbers and lone surrogates are not I-JSON and are refused. sha256 = lower-case hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of canonical. manifestSha256 = sha256 of JCS(manifest without its top-level signature key); a house signature is ed25519 over the 32 raw bytes of manifestSha256.

cases.name: rfc8785_3_2_2_values
cases.note: RFC 8785 section 3.2.2 example: number re-serialisation, string escapes (only " \ and U+0000..U+001F, lower-case hex, / unescaped), literals; members sorted.

cases.name: rfc8785_3_2_3_key_order
cases.note: RFC 8785 section 3.2.3 example: member names sorted by UTF-16 code units, so the non-BMP U+1F600 (surrogates D83D DE00) sorts before U+FB33, the reverse of code point order.

input.\u00f6: Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis

cases.canonical: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}

cases.name: nested_objects_and_integer_like_keys
cases.note: Members sorted at every depth; arrays keep their order; empty object and array; integer-like names sort as strings ("1" < "10" < "9"), never in the numeric order JavaScript Object.keys gives them.

cases.name: unicode_member_names
cases.note: Non-BMP and BMP names: UTF-16 code unit order puts U+1F600 before U+FB01 and U+20AC; upper case before lower case; the empty name first. Non-ASCII is written raw (unescaped) in the canonical form.

cases.name: unicode_and_control_strings
cases.note: Strings as JSON.stringify writes them: control characters escaped (\b \t \n \f \r short forms, others \u00xx lower case); DEL, U+2028, U+2029 and non-BMP characters raw; quote and backslash escaped; solidus raw.

cases.name: non_bmp_emoji_string
cases.note: A well-formed surrogate pair is valid I-JSON and passes: U+1F600 (\ud83d\ude00) and U+1F410 (\ud83d\udc10) are written raw, as their 4-byte UTF-8, in a value and in a name.

cases.name: numbers
cases.note: ECMAScript Number-to-String (RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.3 and Appendix B): -0 is 0; 1e21 and up and below 1e-6 use exponent form with an explicit sign; trailing zeros dropped; the shortest round-trip digits; 2^53+1 is not representable and reads as 2^53.

cases.name: nulls_and_literals
cases.note: null, true and false as literals in members, arrays and nested objects; a null member is kept, never dropped.

cases.name: top_level_array
cases.note: A top-level array or scalar canonicalises too; objects inside it are sorted.

refusedCases.name: lone_high_surrogate_value
refusedCases.refusal: lone UTF-16 surrogate: not I-JSON; HOUSE_STRING_INVALID in a manifest

refusedCases.name: lone_low_surrogate_value
refusedCases.refusal: lone UTF-16 surrogate: not I-JSON; HOUSE_STRING_INVALID in a manifest

refusedCases.refusal: lone UTF-16 surrogate: not I-JSON; HOUSE_STRING_INVALID in a manifest

refusedCases.refusal: lone UTF-16 surrogate: not I-JSON; HOUSE_STRING_INVALID in a manifest

refusedCases.name: lone_surrogate_in_name
refusedCases.refusal: lone UTF-16 surrogate: not I-JSON; HOUSE_STRING_INVALID in a manifest

refusedCases.name: lone_surrogate_nested
refusedCases.refusal: lone UTF-16 surrogate: not I-JSON; HOUSE_STRING_INVALID in a manifest

manifestCases.name: signed
manifestCases.note: A top-level signature is left out of the hash.

manifestCases.name: unsigned_null
manifestCases.note: signature null hashes the same: the hash never depends on the signature.

manifestCases.name: no_signature_key
manifestCases.note: No signature key at all hashes the same again.

manifestCases.name: nested_signature_kept
manifestCases.note: Only the top-level signature is removed: a member field named signature is hashed like any other.

manifestCases.name: min_equity_by_contract
manifestCases.note: The optional minEquityByContract (GOAT-EA#236 cent accounts): standard and cent floors, hashed like any other field.
